regime_context: Hong Kong thematic landscape is narrow and defensive: only four themes pass the absolute-trend eligibility gate (Banks, Energy, High-Dividend Blue Chips, Conglomerates & Exchange), all at the top of the momentum ranks, and the detector explicitly tags the leader Banks as mean-reverting, crowded, and not a validated alpha signal. The rotation read is non-directional with a thin eligible base (4/17) and no validated handoff edge, so this note is a low-conviction, mainly risk-triage exercise rather than a directional call card.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) can close the gap to Banks (margin 0.168) AND hold its trend gate eligibility while Banks loses leadership; the observable that would retire this watch is Energy's rank-2 score falling back below 1.0 or Banks' score staying above 1.2 with its crowded flag intact through the next 15 trading days.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only top-ranked theme that combines a genuine trend HURST tag, a solid durability bar (0.68, the highest among eligible names), non-crowded texture (z 0.24), and full trend-gate eligibility. In a regime where the detector's one validated edge is trend-gate drawdown control, Energy is the cleanest expression of that discipline: the gate is keeping it in while nearly every other theme is gated out.
evidence: rotation: challenger to Banks with margin 0.168 (not a confirmed handoff, but the only eligible challenger)
theses.dissent: The rotation radar is directionally false and the eligible base is only 4 names, so this may simply be the least-bad cyclical in a market where nothing trends reliably; the 'trend' HURST tag on a single-theme sample proves no forward edge.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) lags the Hang Seng index by 3% or more within the 20-day horizon

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips is the most durable defensive expression in an environment where unscheduled macro share is 1.0 (every recent headline is a surprise) and the dominant macro narratives are AI and geopolitics. It is eligible, mixed HURST with a healthy 0.64 durability bar, decent breadth (0.625), and uncrowded. The lean is purely a stability/tail-control view consistent with the gate's validated drawdown-reduction function, not a momentum call.
evidence: durability_bar 0.64 with mixed HURST and breadth 0.625
theses.dissent: In a surprise-heavy regime, high-dividend names can still draw down if global rates or China policy shift abruptly; the detector's trend gate helps but offers no timing or alpha benefit for this theme specifically.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips draw down more than 5% from current level on the Hang Seng within 30 days
